title: roundtrip report
description: What check roundtrip finds, from check roundtrip -o json: whether each flow comes back the same after e-designer writes it and reads it again. A flow that does not fails the check.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always RoundtripReport, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

flows.description: One per flow, in id order.

reason.description: Why not, an open word programs decide by; absent when it came back the same. Known words: refused: e-designer would not write it again, or could not read it back; changed: it came back different from what was written.

says.description: The same for people; present exactly when reason is.
